The '''Treaty of Raquish''' was signed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] and restricted the use of military forces by the group of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] known as the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], amid a period of escalating tensions between the Free Colonies and the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], the anti-Republic [[Media/Legends|news]] and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] reported on the Free Colonies supposedly employing [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] against the inhabitants of Ando, an act that was characterized as a direct violation of the treaty.

==Description==
The Treaty of Raquish was a pact<ref name="Insider67" /> that shared its name with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Raquish system/Legends|Raquish system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It restricted the use of military forces by<ref name="Insider67" /> the fifteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|30|Andosha II}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Breaking their own longstanding weapons restrictions against the Andoan people, the Republic has armed Aqualish loyalists against the Andoan natives that have separated from the Republic.|CIS Shadowfeed news report|<ref name="Insider67" />}}
The Treaty of Raquish was signed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of its efforts to demilitarize<ref name="Insider67" /> [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Aqualish,<ref name="CSWE Ando">{{CSWECite|I|30|Ando}}</ref> and its surrounding [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The treaty came into effect<ref name="Insider67" /> in the wake of the [[Battle of Raquish]], the [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] engagement that ended the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]] between the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], a group of Aqualish-colonized worlds under Ando's influence, and the Andoan Free Colonies.<ref name="EGTW" />

Subsequently,<ref name="Insider67" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Ando [[Secession of Ando|seceded]] from the Republic,<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref> eventually leading to re-escalating tensions between the planet and the Free Colonies. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[21 BBY/Legends|14:4:12]] release of the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] [[Media/Legends|news]] and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program of the Republic's enemy, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], informed that [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] supposedly hired by the Free Colonies had "harassed" the Aqualish of Ando. The report went on to characterize that act as a direct violation of the Treaty of Raquish.<ref name="Insider67" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Treaty of Raquish was mentioned in "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:4:12 Edition]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[CIS Shadowfeed (Insider)|in-universe news report]]. It was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider67" /> on [[March 28]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
